name: outro-4-notebook
notes: Story panels between and after the rooms.

slots.subject: A small worn leather notebook with a brass clasp lying open on a stone doorstep at the foot of a huge iron door, a stub of pencil on its blank page, orange light from under the door falling across it. Nobody in the picture, no hands.
slots.camera: Close view from low at a slight angle.
slots.composition: The open notebook in the foreground, the bottom of the door behind it.
